name: beyond-bliss-regimes-v1-addendum-2
frozen: 2026-11-06, after the calibrated-Bliss addendum and before this control was computed. Post hoc.
reason: The R >= 75 gain of selected F2 survives isotonic recalibration of Bliss. A learned two-argument noninteraction surface g(mono_a, mono_b) could still explain it without pair identity. The sprint's mono_only network (training-pair monotherapy inputs only, no drug or cell identity) is that surface; its out-of-fold predictions already exist for seeds 2026-2028.
analyses: interaction residual R2 of mono_only relative to Bliss, per declared regime
interaction residual R2 of selected F2 relative to mono_only, per declared regime
interpretation: If F2 keeps a positive Holm-corrected interval against mono_only at R >= 75 in every seed, the gain needs pair or drug identity; otherwise it is a better noninteraction surface, not pair-specific interaction.
rule: same intervals, Holm correction and seed requirement as the declared analysis; regimes stay defined by the original R
